facts.fact: The Star reports that the Judiciary is finalising an AI Adoption Policy and Practice Directions barring judicial officers from uploading confidential case data to unapproved systems and requiring human verification of AI citations.
facts.system: Judiciary AI Adoption Policy and Practice Directions

KEN.note: The AI tool is inside the justice sector, which is sectoral.

facts.fact: The Star reports that the Kenyan Judiciary has developed and piloted an internal legal research tool, Mahakama AI, to support judges and judicial officers.
The Star reports that the Judiciary developed and piloted Mahakama AI in-house, an internal legal research tool.
